label: Physical Fiction
description: Materializes a speculative world as an inspectable object, prototype, prop, or exhibit that lets viewers infer systems, users, and rules.

theory_mapping.source_notes: 思辨设计tools-3.pdf page 3, Physical Fictions / 实体虚构.

model_constraints: Materialize the fictional world through an inspectable artifact, prop, prototype, label, document, or exhibit.
Do not present the artifact as a ready commercial product.
Let viewers infer users, rules, institutions, and tensions from concrete material details.
Preserve the artifact's speculative status instead of pretending it is real.

ui.short_description: Materializes a speculative world as an inspectable object, prototype, prop, or exhibit that lets viewers infer systems, users, and rules.

recommendation.reason: Physical Fiction aims to materialize a fictional world as an inspectable object, so it should normally produce both an artifact brief and a visual/object prompt.
best_when: The input already contains a scenario, world rule, institution, or value conflict.
The user needs a prop, prototype, label, exhibit, or object that lets viewers infer a wider world.
The output should support discussion through material detail rather than explanation alone.
warnings: The artifact should celebrate its fictional status rather than pretending to be a market-ready product.
